focus_areas: Scale texture realism in the black region
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the texture of the black skin/scales. AI models often struggle with fine scale details in dark regions, resulting in smooth or noisy patches. Verify if the transition between black and yellow is optically sharp or digitally blended. Crucially, verify the shape of the tail on the right side—it should be rounded with a dark margin. Since the mouth and anal fin are missing, do not penalize for their absence, but ensure the visible anatomy (eye position, body curve, tail shape) is biologically plausible for an Angelfish.
image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor). The image captures the anterior black section of the body and head on the left, transitioning to the posterior golden-yellow section on the right. The eye is partially visible on the far left edge. The dorsal fin runs along the top, and the rounded caudal fin (tail) is clearly visible on the right side, featuring a distinct dark margin.
